description: This source file defines utility methods for handling objects, including serialization, deserialization, size measurement, hash code computation, and factory-based object creation. It belongs to the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.util' package and is part of the OFBiz framework's utility classes.

classes.name: UtilObject
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for object serialization, deserialization, size estimation, hash code calculation, and factory-based object instantiation.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Serializes an object to a byte array.

methods.name: getByteCount
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a serialized object.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array back to an object with error logging.

methods.name: getObjectException
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array to an object, throws exceptions if errors occur.

methods.name: doHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an object, including array contents.

methods.name: getObjectFromFactory
methods.description: Creates an object instance from a specified Factory interface using Java's ServiceLoader.
